Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the implementation huddle for the Riverside Urgent Care Clinic emergency blood-product reserve. I know we have transfusion medicine, laboratory operations, courier services, and nursing education represented here today. Before we dive into the specifics, I want to remind everyone that under our huddle documentation policy, any source document or protocol used to set a requirement must be formally disclosed through the meeting record before I can rely on it in my final decision.

So let's work through this systematically. Riverside currently has no blood products assigned to its inventory, and the request is for an emergency reserve that would be stored on-site at Riverside and replenished through our hospital blood bank. I'd like to hear from each of you on the operational considerations. Who would like to start?
